items.title: Albert Artigues Sr. Interview, 1961-12-15
items.q: I played with him too, with Hal Morento... we were supposed to cut the peculiar rag on a record with that group... Philly Mill on bass... we rehearsed at Hal's Barbershop

ctx.x: I saw him when I was down there...I think in the Navy in 1945...I used to see him there...
Well how does Johnny Miller fit in there...is he related to them at all?
